area_food_guide.title: Hauz Khas Village & SDA Market Living Food Guide
area_food_guide.vibe_badge: Bohemian 13th-century stone monuments meet lakeside study cafes, designer ateliers, and indie sunset terraces.
area_food_guide.famous_for_summary: Lakeside wood-fired pizzas, Himalayan steamed tingmo & momos, artisanal pour-over coffees, and rooftop sunset dining.
area_food_guide.best_time_to_visit: 11:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Midday laptop study sessions transitioning into golden hour lakeside terrace views)
area_food_guide.nearest_metro: Green Park Metro Station (Yellow Line, Exit Gate 2) or IIT Delhi Metro Station (Magenta Line, Exit Gate 1)
area_food_guide.parking_tips: Vehicular access inside the narrow lanes of Hauz Khas Village is restricted. Park at the designated MCD Multilevel Car Parking at the HKV main barrier or near the Deer Park entry gate; explore the alleys on foot.

famous_dishes.name: Steamed Vegetable Tingmo with Spicy Ema Datchi
famous_dishes.why_famous: Cloud-soft Tibetan flower-shaped steamed bread served alongside Bhutanese chili and fermented yak-cheese dipping gravy.

venues.name: The Tea Room from Blossom Kochhar
venues.short_description: Tranquil book-lined French tea salon with tree-canopy views, organic brews, and savory crepes.
venues.long_description: Situated on the first floor overlooking the verdant fringes of Deer Park, The Tea Room offers a calm, minimalist escape with whitewashed walls, wooden bookshelves, and soft acoustic tunes. Popular among university scholars from IIT and NIFT for quiet study sessions and laptop work, the cafe features comfortable plush seating and strong Wi-Fi. Signature offerings include single-estate organic Darjeeling teas, herb-infused iced coolers, and freshly baked savory mushroom crepes.
venues.landmark: Above Blossom Kochhar Aroma Magic, Near HKV Entry

items.name: Darjeeling First Flush Makaibari
items.description: Single-estate spring harvest black tea with delicate muscatel floral undertones.

items.name: Iced Hibiscus Rose Cooler
items.description: Steeped organic Egyptian hibiscus petals, rose water mist, and crushed mint over ice.

items.name: Forest Mushroom & Thyme Crepe
items.description: Buckwheat crepe folded with sauteed button and shiitake mushrooms in a light bechamel.

venues.name: Coast Café
venues.short_description: Sunlit coastal-inspired boutique cafe serving Kerala vegetarian curries, appams, and artisan coffee.
venues.long_description: Spread across two airy upper floors above OGAAN boutique, Coast Cafe is a design-forward institution known for high ceilings, rattan furniture, and abundant natural light. The relaxed daytime vibe makes it a sought-after meeting place for fashion designers, NIFT students, and remote workers looking for spacious tables. The kitchen excels in South Indian coastal comfort food made with fresh coconut milk, alongside continental small plates.

items.name: Coast Vegetable Moilee
items.description: Mild, fragrant coconut curry with carrots, French beans, cauliflower, ginger, and green chilies.

items.name: Hot Steaming Appams (Pair)
items.description: Lacy fermented rice-and-coconut hoppers with soft spongy centers and crispy frills.

items.name: Crispy Avocado & Corn Tacos
items.description: Soft flour tortillas stuffed with tempura avocado, sweet charred corn, pico de gallo, and spicy mayo.

venues.name: MIABELLA
venues.short_description: Scenic rooftop casual dining bistro overlooking the historic lake and 14th-century madrasa.
venues.long_description: Perched at the edge of the historic village, MIABELLA boasts panoramic sunset views across the Hauz Khas reservoir and lush wilderness of Deer Park. With a coastal European aesthetic featuring whitewashed brickwork, teal window shutters, and a romantic rooftop deck, it is a premier venue for leisurely afternoon dates and work-break lunches. The menu spotlights hand-crafted Italian pizzas, penne pastas, Mediterranean mezze platters, and artisan mock cocktails.
venues.landmark: Near Hauz Khas Fort Entrance Gate

items.name: Classic Margherita con Bufala
items.description: San Marzano plum tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Quattro Formaggi Bianca
items.description: White base pizza topped with mozzarella, gorgonzola, aged parmesan, and creamy ricotta with roasted garlic.

items.name: Wild Porcini & Truffle Risotto
items.description: Creamy Carnaroli rice cooked in aromatic vegetable broth with porcini mushrooms and truffle butter.

venues.name: Lama Kitchen - Himalayan Cook House
venues.short_description: Authentic Himalayan restaurant serving Tibetan, Nepalese, and Bhutanese delicacies with lake vistas.
venues.long_description: Perched on the second floor with panoramic windows looking out onto Hauz Khas lake and medieval ruins, Lama Kitchen is known for its warm Tibetan prayer flags, pine wood seating, and soulful mountain music. The kitchen honors genuine Himalayan recipes from Tibet, Nepal, and Bhutan. Vegetarian diners rave about their handmade tingmo steamed breads, fiery ema datchi, crispy vegetable momos, and traditional Nepalese vegetarian thalis.

items.name: Steamed Tibetan Vegetable Momos
items.description: Minced cabbage, carrots, cottage cheese, and mountain herbs encased in thin hand-rolled dough, served with fiery sesame chili chutney.

items.name: Steamed Tingmo (Pair)
items.description: Fluffy, cloud-soft steamed flower-shaped yeast rolls, perfect for soaking up rich curries.

items.name: Bhutanese Vegetable Ema Datchi
items.description: Authentic Bhutanese national dish with sliced green chilies and mushrooms stewed in fermented cheese sauce.

venues.name: The Potbelly - Hauz Khas
venues.short_description: Acclaimed regional rooftop kitchen showcasing authentic Bihari cuisine, litti chokha, and sattu parathas.
venues.long_description: Perched on the top floor of Hauz Khas Market with sweeping views over the surrounding treetops, The Potbelly is a nationally celebrated culinary gem run by a mother-daughter duo. It brings the rich, rustic culinary heritage of Bihar into a chic bohemian dining space with colorful tapestries and bamboo lamps. Known especially for pure desi ghee preparations, their vegetarian spread features litti chokha, sattu parathas, and spiced chana ghughni.
venues.address_line1: Plot No G-2, 3rd Floor, Hauz Khas Market

items.name: Traditional Litti Chokha Platter
items.description: Wood-fire roasted whole wheat dough balls stuffed with spiced roasted gram sattu, immersed in desi ghee, served with baingan and aloo chokha.

items.name: Sabudana & Sattu Cutlets
items.description: Crispy pan-fried sago and spiced sattu patties flavored with green chilies, served with zesty coriander relish.

venues.name: Nukkad Cafe And Bar
venues.short_description: Rustic courtyard cafe with fairy-lit trees, live music, and comforting Indian street-cafe eats.
venues.long_description: Located directly across the street from IIT Delhi in the bustling SDA Market, Nukkad Cafe is an essential college institution. With its open courtyard under a leafy canopy adorned with fairy lights and earthen clay kulhads, it is packed every afternoon and evening with students debating and unwinding. The menu balances comforting street snacks like peri peri momos and pav bhaji with North Indian gravies, thin crust pizzas, and herbal teas.
venues.address_line2: Opposite IIT Main Gate, Safdarjung Development Area
venues.landmark: Above Lorenzo Spa, Near IIT Metro Station
venues.city: SDA Market / Hauz Khas, South Delhi

items.name: Tandoori Malai Soya Chaap
items.description: Tender soya chaap chunks marinated in cashew paste, thick cream, and roasted over hot coals.

items.name: Nukkad Special Adrak Elaichi Kulhad Chai
items.description: Freshly crushed ginger and cardamom slow-simmered in whole milk, served in an unglazed earthen kulhad.

venues.name: The Chai Story
venues.short_description: Cozy student study cafe with board games, kulhad tea varieties, maggi bowls, and quick bites.
venues.long_description: Designed explicitly as a comfortable pocket-friendly study nook for students from IIT Delhi, The Chai Story in SDA Market offers pastel yellow interiors, cushioned booth benches, and shelves packed with board games. Many visitors set up laptops here for group projects and exam prep. The kitchen serves numerous comfort options including five styles of Maggi, grilled cheese sandwiches, nacho chaats, and warming milk teas.
venues.address_line2: Opposite IIT Flyover, Safdarjung Development Area
venues.landmark: Near IIT Metro Station Exit Gate 1
venues.city: SDA Market / Hauz Khas, South Delhi

items.name: Cheese & Butter Tadka Maggi
items.description: Classic Maggi noodles cooked with finely chopped onions, green chilies, extra Amul butter, and grated processed cheese.

items.name: Masala Kulhad Chai
items.description: Rich milk tea brewed with whole cloves, cinnamon, ginger, and cardamom, poured in a traditional mud cup.

venues.name: Evergreen Sweet House & Restaurant
venues.short_description: Legendary multi-level pure-vegetarian dining institution famous for chole bhature, chaat, and North Indian curries.
venues.long_description: Established in 1963 in Green Park Market right next to Hauz Khas, Evergreen Sweet House is a massive multi-level pure-vegetarian dining landmark with a spacious 90-seat dining hall. Frequented by university professors, families, and students, the restaurant delivers authentic North Indian, South Indian, and Chinese dishes. Standouts include their puffy paneer chole bhature, dal makhani, masala dosas, and freshly churned sweet lassi.
venues.city: Green Park / Hauz Khas, South Delhi

items.name: Paneer Stuffed Chole Bhature (2 Pcs)
items.description: Puffy golden bhaturas stuffed with grated cottage cheese, served with dark spiced Punjabi pindi chole, pickle, and onions.

items.name: Raj Kachori Royale
items.description: Crisp giant hollow kachori loaded with spiced lentils, diced potatoes, sweetened dahi, tangy saunth, and pomegranate seeds.

items.name: Evergreen Special Dal Makhani
items.description: Black lentils slow-cooked overnight on charcoal fire with cream, white butter, and aromatic spices.
